facts: What helps an AI model learn patterns?
Models learn statistical patterns from examples in data.
In supervised learning, what is a label?
Labels identify the target associated with training examples.
What is a feature in machine learning?
An input characteristic used by a model
Features are measurable inputs used for prediction.
What can unrepresentative training data cause?
Skewed data can produce unfair or inaccurate outcomes.
What should a child avoid sharing with a public AI tool?
Personal data should be protected when using online tools.
A plausible but incorrect generated answer
Generative models can produce confident-sounding false information.
Who should verify important AI outputs?
Human judgement is important for consequential decisions.
Why keep test data separate from training data?
To measure performance on unseen examples
Unseen test data helps measure generalisation.
Doing well on training data but poorly on new data
An overfit model memorises training details rather than generalising.
A model is too simple to capture useful patterns
A model has too much storage
A model uses too many colours
Underfit models fail even on basic patterns in training data.
What does a classifier usually do?
Assign an input to a category
Regression models estimate continuous numerical outcomes.
Does high model confidence guarantee correctness?
Confidence is an estimate and can be wrong or miscalibrated.
What is a prompt for a generative AI system?
A prompt gives the model instructions, questions, or context.
Why can adding context improve an AI answer?
It clarifies what the user needs
Relevant context can guide the model toward a more appropriate response.
How can you check an AI factual claim?
Important claims should be verified against trustworthy evidence.
Why should generated content be reviewed before publishing?
It may contain errors or rights issues
Human review helps catch factual, safety, and rights problems.
What does AI fairness aim to reduce?
Fairness work looks for and mitigates harmful disparities.
What does transparency in AI help users understand?
How a system is used and its limits
Clear explanations of purpose, data, and limits support responsible use.
People can over-trust automated recommendations even when they are wrong.
A mathematical system learned from data or rules
Models transform inputs into outputs using learned or designed relationships.
What is inference in machine learning?
Using a trained model to produce an output
Inference is the stage where a trained model makes predictions or generations.
Why split data into training, validation, and test sets?
To develop and evaluate a model more fairly
Separate sets reduce leakage and improve evaluation.
What should come before choosing an AI tool?
A clear purpose and risk check
Purpose, users, risks, and safeguards should guide tool choice.
Why should an AI system state its limitations?
So users know when not to rely on it
Known limits help people use AI more safely and appropriately.
